legal-ai-chatbox.title: AI-Powered-Legal-PDF-Querying-Assistant-LexiBot
legal-ai-chatbox.description: AI-powered chatbot that answers questions from legal PDF documents using semantic retrieval and LLMs, with source-backed responses.
legal-ai-chatbox.about: Legal AI Chatbot is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) application that lets users ask natural-language questions about legal documents and receive accurate, source-backed answers. Users upload legal PDFs, which are parsed, chunked, and embedded into a vector store. When a question is asked, the system performs semantic search to retrieve the most relevant passages, then passes them to a large language model to generate a grounded response. Every answer includes citations pointing back to the exact page and section of the source document, reducing hallucinations and building trust. The app features a clean chat interface with conversation history, document management, and highlighted source snippets.
